items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi: Master all four prerequisites, awaken as a True Demon Lord, eat 20 Soul Essences, own at least five Unique skills and have at least 35,000,000 current EP. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Shadow Striker and meet the configured low-health and mob-kill requirements. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Raphael, Lord of Wisdom and Beelzebuth, then meet the configured named-subordinate and mastered-skill counts through the ultimate evolution menu. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Murderer and meet the configured Hero of the Village and mastered-skill counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites and meet the configured mastered flame-skill, mob-kill and named-subordinate counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Seeker, Tempter and Multilayer Barrier. Meet the configured named-subordinate, mastered aspectual-magic, Hero of the Village and magicule-capacity requirements. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites, kill at least 5,000 mobs, carry 25 Daemon Essences and master 30 magic abilities and five Battlewills. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Learn Lucifer and meet the configured maximum EP, mastered-skill, analyzed ultimate-submode and magicule-capacity requirements. First obtaining the accompanying Skill Storage moves eligible permanent skills into storage. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites and meet the configured mob-kill, full Lethal Dose use and magicule-capacity requirements. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Saint and meet the configured Hero of the Village and mastered holy-magic counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Metatron and meet the configured Hero of the Village, mastered holy-magic and spiritron-use counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.
Master Investigator and fully investigate the configured number of targets. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites, meet the configured maximum EP and Faust fully-investigated-target count, then use the ultimate evolution menu. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites and meet the configured human-kill and mastered-magic counts. This menu route retains the prerequisites. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master all recipe prerequisites and meet the configured human-kill and mastered-magic counts. Holy-Demonic Inversion's Legion and Alignment changes must exceed their configured thresholds. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.
Master Designer and meet the configured mastered-skill and mob-kill counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Sloth and meet the configured stored-magicule, time-still-in-bed and mob-kill requirements. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Astarte and Belphegor, and meet the configured Astarte recycled-skill count and Belphegor stored-magicule requirement. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Haniel and Day-Night Inversion, meet the configured Hero of the Village count and be in the Ancient Forest biome. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Godly Craftsman and Law Manipulation, engrave the configured number of distinct items and meet the magicule-capacity requirement. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Chosen One, awaken as a True Hero and complete stage three of the courage trial. Multiplayer also requires the True Love condition. Meet the configured maximum EP and magicule capacity. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Babylon, have at least 2,000,000 maximum EP and six greater spirits, and meet the configured magicule-capacity requirement. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Lord of Treasures, have at least 12,000,000 maximum EP and a level-four Light spirit. Put four Orichalcum Blocks, a full Hihiirokane armor set and a Tempest Scale Shield in the main inventory, and meet the magicule-capacity requirement. Lord of Treasures is retained. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master King of Uruk and meet the magicule-capacity requirement. Lord of Treasures may be currently mastered or recorded as mastered in evolution history. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Deal Maker and meet the configured magicule-capacity requirement. Evolves during acquisition checks; enable Nightmare ultimates and this skill's evolution and meet magicule-capacity and ultimate-slot requirements.

Master Tuner, exceed the configured Destiny Change use threshold and meet the magicule-capacity requirement. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Gourmet and Guardian and meet the configured subordinate count and magicule-capacity requirement. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Villain, meet the configured current EP requirement, kill 2,500 humans and complete the No Remorse, No Love and No Shame conditions. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Yog-Sothoth, obtain Courage, Hope and Justice, and meet the configured maximum EP and magicule-capacity requirements. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Witch's Greed and Survivor and meet the configured Hero of the Village and named-subordinate counts. Available through the ultimate evolution menu, subject to its evolution setting, magicule capacity and ultimate slots.

Master Uriel, Lord of Oath, or permanently learn Uriel, Lord of Vow. Also master at least two other ultimates and at least 100 skills in total. Confirm in the ultimate evolution menu and meet magicule-capacity and slot requirements. First obtaining the accompanying Skill Storage moves eligible old permanent skills into storage.

Master Deluge and either Mana Manipulation or Law Manipulation. Have at least 2,000,000 maximum EP, enable automatic ultimate evolution and meet magicule-capacity and slot requirements. Deluge is replaced.
Master all recipe prerequisites and have at least 2,000 Multilayer Barrier points. Enable automatic ultimate evolution and meet magicule-capacity and slot requirements. Elegy is replaced.
Complete self-naming, permanently learn Law Manipulation and Magic Resistance, and master at least 50 skills. Raziel evolution must be enabled.
Master Seeker and meet the configured mastered-skill count to unlock Tempter. Seeker is retained.
Master Tempter and meet the configured mastered-magic count to unlock Seeker. Tempter is retained.
Master Sentient Being and Gluttony and eat the configured number of Dragon Essences.
Permanently learn Gourmet to unlock Food Chain; mastery is not required and Gourmet is retained.
Permanently learn either Gluttony or Starved and reach 100,000 EP to unlock Food Chain. The source skill is retained.
Own either Raphael variant and defeat Hinata Sakaguchi to unlock Future Attack Prediction.
Master Day-Night Inversion magic to unlock Holy-Demonic Inversion.
Owning Asmodeus satisfies Rebirth's skill acquisition condition.
Be an Axolotl and master Self-Regeneration.
After permanently learning Asmodeus, receive Godspeed Regeneration for free if it is absent. Asmodeus is retained.
